description: This file contains functions for collecting and assigning authentication profile credentials (API key and token types) within a runtime context, including validation and policy enforcement.

methods.name: collectApiKeyProfileAssignment
methods.description: Collects and assigns API key credentials, resolving references and issuing warnings if plaintext keys are overridden.

methods.name: collectTokenProfileAssignment
methods.description: Collects and assigns token credentials, resolving references and issuing warnings if plaintext tokens are overridden.

methods.name: collectAuthStoreAssignments
methods.description: Main exported function that processes an entire auth profile store, enforcing policies and delegating to specific credential collection functions.
